original.target_description: Experiment 1: imagined candy-bar choices by young adult business students at 9 AM versus 4 PM. The broad description and p. 5 locator do not uniquely distinguish the time-by-brand interaction, time contrasts for Snickers or Pay Day, or within-time brand contrasts.

es.location: Experiment 1, section 2.3 Results, printed p. 217 (PDF p. 5); layout visually checked
es.quote:
Specific choice incidences for the leader brand (Snickers) and for the focal follower
brand (Pay Day) were also examined in a 2 × 2 mixed ANOVA, with time of day and brand
as between- and within-subjects factors, respectively.

notes: Only es_value_o is assigned; all other fields are non-overwriting placeholders. Target unresolved: p. 217 reports multiple relevant tests. Printed candidates: switching main effect F(1, 42) = 17.30, p < .01, peak M = 3.55 and low M = 5.41; time-by-brand interaction λ = .46, F(1, 42) = 49.62, p < .01; Snickers time contrast peak M = 2.41 versus low M = 1.72, F(1, 42) = 9.06, p < .01; Pay Day time contrast low M = 1.73 versus peak M = .36, F(1, 42) = 63.85, p < .01; brand contrast within low λ = .98, F(1, 21) = .02, p > .98; brand contrast within peak λ = .21, F(1, 21) = 77.46, p < .01.
